product.name: Handcrafted Gnocchi from Sicily
product.shortDescription: Picture soft, pillowy gnocchi embraced by zesty lemon ricotta. Fresh pistachio pesto swirls through—a perfect harmony of bright, Sicilian flavours!
product.description:
HANDCRAFTED GNOCCHIItalian Cook & Dine Experience

Winter Warmers Edition

Cold outside.
Inside? Golden arancini. Pillowy gnocchi. Lemon ricotta. Pistachio pesto. Crisp cannoli.

This is winter, but with Italian sunshine on the table.

Handcrafted Gnocchi is Roving Larder’s Italian Cook & Dine experience — hands-on, generous, bright, comforting, and absolutely worth leaving the couch for.

You’ll cook.
You’ll sip.
You’ll learn.
Then you’ll sit down at our long table and enjoy a beautiful Italian-inspired meal you helped create.

It’s part cooking class, part dinner party, part little escape to Italy.

No passport required.
Just closed shoes and an appetite.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT

This is not just a gnocchi class.

It’s a full Italian night out — with you in the kitchen.

You’ll learn how to make soft, pillowy gnocchi from scratch, create flavour-packed sauces, fry golden arancini, and finish with crisp cannoli filled with lemon curd and mascarpone.

It’s relaxed, hands-on, social, and deliciously satisfying.

Perfect for date nights, birthdays, gifts, catch-ups with friends, team celebrations, or anyone who believes winter should come with arancini, gnocchi, cannoli, and wine.

HANDS-ON COOKING & DINING EXPERIENCE

This is not a cooking demo where you sit quietly while the chef does all the fun bits.

At Roving Larder, you get involved.

Your chef will guide you step by step through the menu, sharing practical techniques, timing tips, and little kitchen tricks that make Italian cooking feel achievable at home.

You’ll roll gnocchi, shape arancini, build beautiful sauces, fill cannoli, taste as you go, and enjoy the buzz of a warm kitchen.

Then comes the best part.

You sit down at the long table and enjoy the meal you helped create — with good company, a drink in hand, and that very smug little feeling of, “Yes, I made this.”

WHAT YOU’LL COOK

Starter

Arancini with Bocconcini & Tomato Sauce
Crispy risotto balls with melted bocconcini centres, fried until golden and served with a bright, tangy tomato sauce.

Main

Handcrafted Gnocchi with Lemon Ricotta & Pistachio Pesto
Delicate homemade gnocchi tossed with zesty lemon ricotta and finished with vibrant, nutty pistachio pesto.

Dessert

Cannoli with Lemon Curd & Mascarpone
Golden, crisp cannoli shells filled with tangy lemon curd and mascarpone, topped with white chocolate and pistachios.

TECHNIQUES YOU’LL LEARN

During this Italian Cook & Dine experience, you’ll learn how to:

  • Make gnocchi dough from scratch

  • Roll and shape light, pillowy gnocchi

  • Create a vibrant lemon ricotta and pistachio pesto finish

  • Prepare golden arancini with bocconcini centres

  • Fry safely and confidently

  • Fill cannoli with lemon curd and mascarpone

  • Add simple finishing touches with white chocolate and pistachio

  • Plate your dishes beautifully without overcomplicating them

WHAT’S INCLUDED

Your experience includes:

  • Chef-led, hands-on cooking

  • All ingredients and equipment

  • Apron use during the class

  • Welcome nibbles

  • Welcome drink

  • A generous Italian-inspired meal

  • Curated beverages with the meal

  • Recipes to recreate the dishes at home

  • Long-table dining in a relaxed, welcoming setting

ITINERARY

Please arrive 15 minutes before the class start time so we can welcome you properly.

We’ll begin with nibbles and a welcome drink while everyone settles in.

Your chef will then introduce the menu, explain the flow of the class, and guide the group through the cooking experience.

You’ll cook, taste, ask questions, learn new techniques, and enjoy the rhythm of a warm, buzzing kitchen.

Once everything is ready, we gather at the long table to share the meal together.

Good food.
Good drinks.
Good people.
A very good winter night.

WHO IT’S PERFECT FOR

This experience is perfect for:

  • Gnocchi lovers

  • Italian food lovers

  • Couples looking for a cosy winter date night

  • Friends who want something better than another restaurant booking

  • Birthday celebrations

  • Gift experiences

  • Team outings and small groups

  • Anyone who thinks homemade gnocchi and cannoli sound like a very sensible life decision

PLEASE NOTE

Menus may vary slightly depending on seasonal produce and ingredient availability.

Please wear closed shoes for safety in the kitchen.

If you have dietary requirements, please let us know at the time of booking so we can do our best to accommodate you.

BOOK YOUR ITALIAN WINTER ESCAPE

Don’t just sit through winter.

Make it delicious.

Join us for Handcrafted Gnocchi — a warm, hands-on Italian Cook & Dine experience.
